# Evoke Studio

> Evoke Studio is a specialist branding and web design agency founded by Mehedi Hasan. We design custom logos, brand identities, and high-performance websites for startups, small businesses, SaaS companies, and professional services firms in the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. Fixed pricing, no templates, no AI-generated logos — every project is custom and strategy-first.

## About

Evoke Studio (madebyevoke.com) is a boutique branding and web design agency. The founder and lead designer is Mehedi Hasan, CEO. We serve clients globally with a focus on English-speaking markets: USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. We work remotely and deliver all projects as fixed-price engagements with transparent pricing before work begins.

**Contact:** work@madebyevoke.com
**Rating:** 5.0/5 on Clutch
**Projects delivered:** 500+
**Starting price:** $150 (logo design), $500 (brand identity), $1,500 (web design)

## Services

- [AI Logo Vectorization](https://madebyevoke.com/services/ai-logo-vectorization): Convert AI-generated logos (Midjourney, DALL·E, Ideogram, Firefly) into production-ready vector files. Manual trace — no auto-trace shortcuts. SVG, AI, EPS, PDF delivered in 24–48 hours. From $50.
- [AI Logo Cleanup](https://madebyevoke.com/services/ai-logo-cleanup): Fix distorted letterforms, inconsistent strokes, broken symmetry, and unusable details in AI-generated logos. From $75. 24–48hr turnaround.
- [Typography Reconstruction](https://madebyevoke.com/services/typography-reconstruction): Rebuild AI-generated or rasterised text into clean, editable vector type. From $75.
- [SVG Conversion](https://madebyevoke.com/services/svg-conversion): Convert any logo or graphic from raster (PNG, JPEG) to clean SVG vector format. From $50.
- [Brand System Rebuild](https://madebyevoke.com/services/brand-system-rebuild): Reconstruct a complete brand system from damaged, low-resolution, or AI-generated assets. From $200.
- [Logo Design](https://madebyevoke.com/services/logo-design): Custom logo design from scratch — marks, wordmarks, and combination logos. No templates. From $150. 5–7 business days.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://madebyevoke.com/services/brand-identity): Complete visual identity system — logo, colour palette, typography, and brand guidelines. From $500. 10–14 business days.
- [Visual Identity System](https://madebyevoke.com/services/visual-identity-system): Full visual identity including extended applications — stationery, social media templates, pitch deck templates. From $1,200.
- [Business Stationery](https://madebyevoke.com/services/business-stationery): Business card, letterhead, envelope, and email signature design. From $200.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://madebyevoke.com/services/brand-guidelines): Professional brand guidelines document covering logo usage, colour, typography, and do's and don'ts. From $300.
- [Web Design & Development](https://madebyevoke.com/services/web-design-development): Custom websites built on Next.js — fast, SEO-optimised, and conversion-focused. From $1,500. 3–6 weeks.
- [Social Media Design](https://madebyevoke.com/services/social-media-management): On-brand social media content design — Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok. From $300/month.
